description: This file defines the Metadata class and its companion object, along with the MetadataBuilder class, for handling metadata in Apache Spark SQL. It includes methods for serialization, deserialization, comparison, and manipulation of metadata key-value pairs, supporting various data types and JSON conversion.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: A wrapper over Map[String, Any] for storing simple data types and arrays, with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: MetadataBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing Metadata instances, supporting key-value insertion and removal.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the metadata.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the metadata is empty.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Retrieves a Long value for a key.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a Double value for a key.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves a Boolean value for a key.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a String value for a key.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves a Metadata object for a key.

methods.name: getLongArray
methods.description: Retrieves an Array[Long] for a key.

methods.name: getDoubleArray
methods.description: Retrieves an Array[Double] for a key.

methods.name: getBooleanArray
methods.description: Retrieves an Array[Boolean] for a key.

methods.name: getStringArray
methods.description: Retrieves an Array[String] for a key.

methods.name: getMetadataArray
methods.description: Retrieves an Array[Metadata] for a key.

methods.name: withKeysRemoved
methods.description: Returns a new Metadata with specified keys removed.

methods.name: withKeyRemoved

methods.name: json
methods.description: Serializes the Metadata to a JSON string.

methods.name: toString

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another Metadata object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code for the Metadata.

methods.name: toJsonValue

methods.name: hash
